title: CXTMS App Manifest (app.yaml)
description: Top-level app.yaml manifest for a CXTMS app repo. See docs/superpowers/specs/2026-09-27-apps-directory-design.md §2.2 (cx-workspace) for the listing block this feeds into AppDirectoryEntry.Listing.

id.description: Stable app identifier. Equals AppManifest.AppManifestId and, when the app is listed, AppDirectoryEntry.AppManifestId.

icon.description: Names a repo-relative image file that the directory sync uploads to S3 (PNG, JPEG, SVG or WebP, ≤ 256 KB), or is an absolute http(s) URL used as-is. Empty/unset is common in real app.yaml files.

listing.description: Apps Directory card/listing metadata, copied into AppDirectoryEntry.Listing on sync.

configName.description: OrganizationConfig configName rendered on the app page's Configuration tab.

permissions.description: Descriptive permission lines shown in the install dialog. Not enforced.

brand.description: Card mark shown when icon is unset: short mark text on a brand-colored background.

mark.description: Card mark text, e.g. vendor initials or wordmark abbreviation (up to 6 chars; generated initials fall back to 2).

bg.description: Background hex color for the mark.

fg.description: Foreground (text) hex color for the mark.
